newsitem.title: UK: Howden Group mulling bid for the company.
newsitem.headline: Howden Group mulling bid for the company.

text.p: The board of British engineering equipment maker Howden Group Plc said on Friday it was considering an offer for the company.
The company said it would make a further announcement shortly.
Howden also said its Howden Group America Inc unit bought New Philadelphia Fan Co from Harnischfeger Industries Inc for about $17.2 million in cash.
The company, previously known as Joy Green Fan, supplies axial fans to various industries.
Howden's shares were temporarily suspended on the London Stock Exchange at 0800 GMT, pending a further announcement.
On Monday, Howden's shares shot higher on speculation that the company might be the target of a takeover bid.
But the company responded by saying it had not received any approaches, noting that it was in talks to dispose of an undisclosed "non-core business activity".
